description: This file defines the KamonCommandListener class, which implements the MongoDB CommandListener interface to log and record timing metrics for MongoDB commands, including command start, success, and failure events.

classes.name: KamonCommandListener
classes.description: A listener for MongoDB commands that logs command execution details and records timing metrics using Kamon.

methods.name: KamonCommandListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the listener with a specific metric name.

methods.name: commandStarted
methods.description: Handles the event when a MongoDB command is started; logs command details if debug logging is enabled.

methods.name: commandSucceeded
methods.description: Handles the event when a MongoDB command succeeds; logs success details and records elapsed time.

methods.name: commandFailed
methods.description: Handles the event when a MongoDB command fails; logs error details and records elapsed time.

methods.name: recordElapsedTime
methods.description: Records the elapsed time for a command execution using Kamon metrics with appropriate tags.
